what_passed.rolling_acf_vs_fixture_truth: No rolling regression versus spread on lock/unlock, octave, wrong-BPM, acquisition time, reacquisition, silence false locks/ticks, noise false locks/ticks, or settled beat count. Earlier correct lock is observed on jumps (feature).
what_passed.shared_window_goertzel: k1_tempi[*].magnitude_raw bit-identical to spread k1_compute_magnitude (max abs err 0, -ffp-contract=off).

control_gaps_not_rolling_regressions.steady_128_and_144: Neither spread nor rolling locked the synthetic click train after history fill. The host corpus does not prove those BPMs.
control_gaps_not_rolling_regressions.captain_7500us_beat_timing: The spread control itself routinely misses 7.5 ms versus novelty-grid clicks (median offsets of 0-67 ms; p99 often one novelty hop). Rolling is no worse on median. The 7.5 ms bound is tighter than the existing flywheel, which can only tick on emit frames.
control_gaps_not_rolling_regressions.history_fill_lock: First correct lock is 11520 ms = 512 novelty samples × 22.5 ms. That is ring-fill, not a rolling delay.

feasibility_arithmetic.why_no_flash: Rolling ACF plus exact shared-window Goertzel cannot credibly remove 1.8 ms on the S3. Do not spend a B489 cycle pretending this pair closes Gate 2.

honest_remaining_choices: another semantic tempo redesign with a larger saving
